messages:
Maya (partnerships): FYI ACME asked whatwe can publish for the GCP marketplace listing. They specifically asked for: SOC2 summary, pen test exec summary, and an attest that redactions are audited. Need owners.
Jordan (security): I can own SOC summary redaction and the attest. Quick Q: do we publish the SOC2 bridge letter or just a one-page statement + redacted artifacts?
Nora (sales): Partner marketing wants the shortest path to publish. They said a bullet-point SOC statement is ok if we provide the redacted bundle to marketplace reviewers. PR depends on published listing.
Sam (cloud): For ingestion I need a stable path and metadata. Marketplace ingestion expects: metadata.json + checksums. We should include sha256 for each artifact. I'll script upload.
Diego (SI): For pen test the marketplace requires an "exec summary" and a witness availability window. We prefer a 90min remote witness call. I can coordinate scope and a short runbook.
Rina (legal): If we're redacting, legal needs to review redaction rationale. We cannot remove evidence of control failures. Provide a mapping doc: original filename -> redaction reason.
Jordan (security): ack. Plan: produce soc2-redacted.zip + soc2-redaction-map.txt + attest.txt (signed by security lead). I'll flag any items that need legal review inline.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Ingestion schema v2 requires fields: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_types (comma separated), evidence_ts, contact_email, checksum_sha256. See https://marketplace.docs/ingest-v2.
Maya (partnerships): Sam, can you bake metadata.json with checksum? Nora, please confirm contact email for partner and any embargo windows.
Sam (cloud): yes. Example metadata.json snippet Ill generate: {"partner_name":"ACME Gateway","listing_id":"acme-gateway-001","artifact_types":"soc2,pen_test","evidence_ts":"2034567890","contact_email":"nora@redwood.ai","checksum_sha256":"<sha256>"} (placeholder)
Nora (sales): Partner contact is ops@acme.com. They're trying to get CI logs and pen artifacts to us by tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll escalate.
Diego (SI): If logs land late we can still run witness but will note scope gaps. I'll draft a short "scope gap" template we can include with submission.
Rina (legal): Also ensure we don't include third-party customer data in redacted files. If any customer identifiers are present, we need written consent or fully remove those fields. Jordan, flag those during redaction.
Jordan (security): will scrub PII/customer IDs and list removed fields in the redaction map. Expect draft redacted bundle by EOD tomorrow. Need legal thumbs within 4 hours of upload.
Maya (partnerships): timeline recap: partner artifacts -> tomorrow 11:00 PT; redacted bundle + map -> tomorrow EOD (Jordan); legal review -> within 4 hours (Rina); upload & metadata -> Sam will upload once legal clears; witness call -> Diego to schedule Tue/Wed next week. Nora will coordinate partner PR timing.
marketplace-bot: Note: uploads over 50MB require multipart presign. Use CLI example: ```aws s3api create-multipart-upload --bucket redwood-evidence --key partners/acme/2034567890/soc2-redacted.zip```
Sam (cloud): good call. I'll support multipart presigns and automated checksum verification. I'll put a small uploader script in the repo and post link here.
Nora (sales): Partner just confirmed they can deliver logs by 10:30 PT. Will ping here with their ops lead once uploaded.
Rina (legal): quick heads-up: if redaction removes key cryptographic evidence we might need to provide a gated reviewer channel to marketplace only. Jordan, note anything high risk.
Jordan (security): noted. Anything that prevents public acceptance I'll surface ASAP. Otherwise we keep public redaction conservative.
Diego (SI): I'll prepare the witness runbook and add a short checklist: recon scope, auth vectors to test, telemetry endpoints, and acceptable test windows. Will share in an hour.
Maya (partnerships): sweet. Please paste presign links here when ready (remember: redacted only). Do not paste any secrets or private links in this channel. :eyes:
Sam (cloud): will post presigned upload endpoint + metadata.json once legal signs the map. ETA Friday AM.
Nora (sales): I'll update partner and chase any missing artifacts. If legal asks for gated access I'll coordinate a signed NDA for the marketplace reviewer.
Rina (legal): we can do a time-limited gated review link. I'll prepare a short access agreement template.
Maya (partnerships): thanks team. I'll send a one-paragraph summary to marketplace PM once upload is complete. Ping when you hit your tasks. :rocket:
